description: Video Player Pro for Power BI Embed and play videos directly in your Power BI reports and dashboards. Perfect for training materials, product demos, presentations, and instructional content. KEY FEATURES - Multi-format support: MP4, WebM, MKV, AVI, MOV, WMV, and more - Full playback controls: play/pause, speed adjustment (0.5x-2x), volume, seeking - Video bookmarks for quick navigation to key moments - Automatic persistence: videos under 30MB save with your report - Customizable appearance to match your report theme - Fullscreen mode and progress bar with click-to-seek - No external dependencies - all processing happens locally FILE SIZE SUPPORT - Under 30MB: Persists with report (recommended) - 30-200MB: Session playback only - Maximum: 200MB IDEAL FOR Training videos, employee onboarding, product demonstrations, safety procedures, marketing content, and executive communications. PRIVACY & SECURITY No data collection. All processing occurs locally within Power BI. Complies with GDPR and organizational security policies. SUPPORT Developer: Abdalla Dabes, P.E, PSP, PMP Email: AbdallaDabes@AbdallaAIsolutions.onmicrosoft.com Comprehensive documentation and user manual included.
